comparison.objective: Candidate transfers a machined part with lifting hardware; record validates a voltage detector before and after testing a conductor and avoids testing when proof fails.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests precision mechanical locking and suspended-load manipulation; record tests long-stick handling, button coordination, proof-tester contact, conditional sequencing, and safe laydown.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retention, lift, support transfer, extraction, and damage gates; record requires valid prove-test-prove states or safe abstention on a failed tester, followed by distant release.
comparison.reason: The record evaluates safety-conditioned electrical test procedure rather than load-bearing attachment and fixture seating; no material rubric details are missing.
